keyPoints.en: Tin: Perak (Larut, Kinta), Selangor (Klang Valley, Lukut, Ampang), Negeri Sembilan (Sungai Ujong); Pahang: gold and tin.
keyPoints.bm: Bijih timah: Perak (Larut, Kinta), Selangor (Lembah Klang, Lukut, Ampang), Negeri Sembilan (Sungai Ujong); Pahang: emas dan bijih timah.

keyPoints.en: Demand from European industries and unrest (Larut Wars) drew British attention.
keyPoints.bm: Permintaan industri Eropah dan kekacauan (Perang Larut) menarik perhatian British.

keyPoints.en: Perak: Pangkor Treaty, 20 January 1874 (Raja Abdullah Sultan; Resident J.W.W. Birch).
keyPoints.bm: Perak: Perjanjian Pangkor, 20 Januari 1874 (Raja Abdullah Sultan; Residen J.W.W. Birch).

keyPoints.en: Selangor Resident 1875; Sungai Ujong 1874, Negeri Sembilan united 1895; Pahang Resident 1888.
keyPoints.bm: Residen Selangor 1875; Sungai Ujong 1874, Negeri Sembilan disatukan 1895; Residen Pahang 1888.

keyPoints.en: Residential System: advice binding except Islam and Malay custom.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem Residen: nasihat wajib diikuti kecuali agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

keyPoints.en: FMS formed 1 July 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang.
keyPoints.bm: NNMB dibentuk 1 Julai 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang.

keyPoints.en: Reasons: uniform administration, help Pahang, faster economic development, stronger British control.
keyPoints.bm: Sebab: pentadbiran seragam, membantu Pahang, pembangunan ekonomi lebih pesat, kawalan British lebih kukuh.

keyPoints.en: Resident-General (Frank Swettenham) in Kuala Lumpur; Durbar 1897 at Kuala Kangsar; Federal Council 1909.
keyPoints.bm: Residen Jeneral (Frank Swettenham) di Kuala Lumpur; Durbar 1897 di Kuala Kangsar; Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan 1909.

keyPoints.en: Central control reduced the Sultans' power further.
keyPoints.bm: Kawalan pusat semakin mengurangkan kuasa Sultan.
